name: Biography continuity checks without demographic profiling

attribution.legal_posture: Source-qualified defensive abstraction only. The stated evidence class covers a defensive abstraction; legal identity, nationality, employer compromise, prevalence rate, and adjudicated fact require separate sources.

caveats: Claim attribution: Christophe Haubursin, Tunnel Vision controlled interview.
Fraudulent employment and fake-interview malware remain separate analytic tracks absent explicit same-case evidence.
Nervousness, language difficulty, or imprecise geography can have benign explanations.
The record excludes people, personas, accounts, companies, victims, images, contact details, payment selectors, credentials, raw network indicators, and leaked material.

Accent, ethnicity, nationality, appearance, location, camera or audio quality, productivity level, consumer email, shipping change, meeting feature, and technical anomaly are contextual signals; fraud or DPRK attribution requires independent evidence.
The candidate identity was source-labeled and remains legally unadjudicated.
Use behavior and continuity signals only in combination with independent verification, consistently applied human review, least privilege, and an appeal or correction path.

statements: In the controlled interview, the candidate gave inconsistent or thin answers about claimed residence, upbringing, language history, and future in-person work. The useful signal is inconsistency with the claimed biography and independent records, not accent, appearance, nationality, or location alone.
Ask specific, ordinary questions tied to the claimed work and education history, and verify answers through independent records.
Repeat key identity and experience questions across interview rounds to test continuity.
Never turn accent, ethnicity, nationality, camera quality, or geography into standalone rejection rules.
limitations: Claim attribution: Christophe Haubursin, Tunnel Vision controlled interview.
The candidate identity was source-labeled and not legally adjudicated.
Nervousness, language difficulty, or imprecise geography can have benign explanations.

statements: Retain the source's observation class and do not generalize a controlled test, speaker claim, vendor sample, or demonstration into measured prevalence.
limitations: No single accent, ethnicity, nationality, appearance, location, camera or audio quality, productivity level, consumer email, shipping change, meeting feature, or technical anomaly establishes fraud or DPRK attribution.
Use behavior and continuity signals only in combination with independent verification, consistently applied human review, least privilege, and an appeal or correction path.
No people, personas, accounts, companies, victims, images, contact details, payment selectors, credentials, raw network indicators, or leaked material are included.
Fraudulent employment and fake-interview malware remain separate analytic tracks absent explicit same-case evidence.
